description: Everything about one Walrus blob: status (registered, certified, expired, deleted), owner and uploader, size, the register and certify transactions, start and end epoch with an estimated end date, deletable or permanent, shared blob funds, extensions, WAL paid, attributes, and what the content is (image, video, audio, pdf, json, markdown, csv, code, text, html, quilt with its patches, Seal encrypted with its policy package, binary), with a preview URL. Takes a blob id, a quilt patch id, the u256 or a Blob object id. Example: { id: "FHQl1gK7Rb5X5X3Q-DiNe4qvyTojL262p0JUn-ijQkQ" }.

id.description: Blob id (43 characters), quilt patch id (50 characters), u256 in decimal or 0x hex, or a Blob object id.

name: walrus_blob
title: Read a Walrus blob
